notes.title: Improvement Update
notes.notes: [h2]What's new[/h2][p]-New progress reset system! Earn precious diamonds in exchange for your progress. Would you dare to start all over again?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344227/2cb8b0cf772983e28e2cdc5c415624f3585b331a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]-New menu with permanent upgrades available for diamonds! Exchange your diamonds for a permanent, stackable bonus to your Kibbles per Second![/p][p][i]Currently, only one upgrade is available, but a batch of new upgrades are planned.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344227/df70c281d789447b700ff7bed8d715fc2156380d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]-New Steam achievements added accordingly! Accept the challenge to start all over again, and spend your first diamonds![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344227/c23c08e0182ab62d52b3d2da664352367daee190.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]PATCH[/h2][p]-Now you can choose your game background from all the ones you have purchased! Gone are the days when it was impossible to choose the background you had loved so much and where you had to play with the recently purchased one.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344227/faa3edd20a41307f80ebb53f84fd1ac33b54b2b6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]And finally... thank you![/h2][p]Lately, I've received many positive reviews of the game. Thank you for your patience and your perspective on the overall state of the game. I take the time to read and respond to each of them with pleasure. Your comments greatly encourage me to continue improving CroquettesClicker![/p][p]Your comments mean a lot to me![/p]

notes.title: Improvement Update
notes.notes: [h2][b]Added[/b][/h2][p]- The game now features a custom Discord status, with the game icon, your total number of Croquettes, and your number of Croquettes per second. Proudly show everyone how far you've come in conquering the world![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344227/5db236e2d987c118dc7f33b36036ebd722daad08.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]-A new button has appeared in the shop, but for the moment it is still locked... Could it be hiding something grandiose?[/p]

notes.title: Improvement Update
notes.notes:
-Now [b]large numbers are much more readable[/b].
-A [b]daily reward[/b] has arrived! (@Suggestions discussion)

notes.title: Improvement Update
notes.notes:
It is now possible to switch the game to [b]windowed mode[/b] by pressing [b]ESC[/b] during the game.

The cat remains in the foreground. A [i]minor correction[/i] remains to be made to adjust the size of the buttons depending on the window, and will be included in a future update.

notes.title: Patch update
notes.notes:
[h2]Corrections[/h2]
-The prices of improvements have been lowered (@Suggestions discussion)
-Fixed the bowl which blocked clicks when purchasing it (@Suggestions discussion)
-Now the volume set for the music is saved (@Suggestions discussion)

notes.title: Patch
notes.notes: Le bug de la gamelle qui bloque les clics a été fixé.

notes.title: Update improvement
notes.notes:
[h2]Visual[/h2]
-Improved the appearance of upgrade buttons, shop buttons and mini-game buttons.
-Better readability of buttons with changing the font.
-Added a slight background to each button category to better distinguish the different menus.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
-Added levels for each improvement.
